# Nihal T P (nihaltp)

> Portfolio of Nihal T P — a Computer Science student and developer at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology (RIT), Kottayam. Previously completed a Diploma in Automation & Robotics at College of Engineering Vadakara (2022–2025). Known online as @nihaltp.

This domain (nihaltp.github.io) redirects to the main portfolio at nihaltp.vercel.app.

## Main Portfolio

- [Portfolio (nihaltp.vercel.app)](https://nihaltp.vercel.app/): Main portfolio — hero, education, hackathons, and apps
- [llms.txt](https://nihaltp.vercel.app/llms.txt): LLM-friendly overview of the main portfolio site

## Apps

- [F-Droid Repository](https://nihaltp.github.io/fdroid): Personal F-Droid repo hosting open-source Android apps built by Nihal T P
- [Apps listing](https://nihaltp.vercel.app/apps): Full list of Flutter/mobile apps
